About Me

Technology Professional • Insurance Advisor • Lifelong Learner

Who I Am

Hello, I'm Santanu Mukherjee. I have spent nearly three decades in Information Technology, gaining experience in software development, complex problem solving, and continuous system optimization.

Alongside technology, I serve as a licensed Insurance Advisor. Financial protection is one of the most meaningful ways to empower individuals and families, and my goal is to simplify these decisions through clarity and trust.

My Journey

Technology taught me structured thinking and logical problem-solving. Insurance taught me the importance of listening and understanding people's real-world financial needs.

Why Insurance?

Insurance is not simply about policies—it is about protecting families, planning for the future, and building financial confidence before critical decisions need to be made.

Why Technology?

Technology is constantly evolving. My background helps me leverage modern tools, static web architectures, and automation to deliver value efficiently.
